$comment: Where to watch, per market. There is no reliable free API for broadcast rights, so this is maintained data. Rights change between seasons, so each entry records verified_on and the source it was checked against. Editable at runtime from /admin without a redeploy.
note: The UK Saturday 3pm blackout does not apply in any of these four markets, so every match is available to all four people.

markets.label: Ukraine
markets.note: Setanta holds Ukrainian rights for the 2025-26 to 2027-28 cycle, all 380 matches.

markets.label: United States
markets.note: NBCUniversal is the exclusive US home through 2027-28. Peacock streams roughly 175 matches exclusively; the rest split across NBC (free-to-air) and USA Network, which is why US listings need per-fixture overrides.

markets.label: Canada
markets.note: Fubo holds exclusive Canadian rights from 2025-26 through 2027-28, all 380 matches. Sportsnet, TSN and CBC do not carry the Premier League in this cycle.

champions_league.note: Champions League rights were not verified for this cycle. Shown with a caveat in the UI until confirmed.
